subject: Quick 5-day bridge while PO clears — request for demo tokens
messages:
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@healthlytics.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick favor — PO in flight, can we keep demo live?

Hi Connor,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team loved the latency numbers on the streaming path. We just routed the PO to procurement this morning but finance flagged a standard vendor onboarding review that will likely take 6–8 business days. Our pilot window ends next Thursday and we'd lose momentum if access drops.

Would Redwood be able to provide a short bridge (5 business days) of demo credits or a temporary token grant so we can keep running the integration tests while procurement completes? We don't need much — roughly 300k tokens worth of inference — just enough to validate a production-ish run.

If you need an internal PO number or anything I can push from our side, let me know. Appreciate any help to keep the pilot alive.

Thanks,
Maya Srinivasan
Head of Data & AI
Healthlytics

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@healthlytics.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick favor — PO in flight, can we keep demo live?

Hey Maya — really glad the demo resonated. Totally understand the procurement drag.

We can provide a short runway while your PO clears. I can offer a 5-day bridge for up to 350k tokens as a one-time courtesy. To proceed I just need two things: (1) confirmation from you that 350k tokens will be sufficient, and (2) a PO number or internal ticket reference when available for our records.

Vanessa / Ben — tagging you both for approval of the token grant (deal RDW-5421). This is a small one-off to preserve momentum; we'll reconcile once the PO lands.

Maya — if that works I will provision the tokens and send the temporary credit file + console link.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
